name: pi-harness-model-proposer
description: Dedicated-model proposer for pi-continual-harness. Registers a /refine proposer ('model') that makes its own one-shot LLM call (via the harness's injected complete closure) to produce evidence-backed CRUD deltas directly — hidden from the transcript but audited (model/tokens/latency recorded in the refine entry). Validates/sanitizes model output against current state so the harness's all-or-nothing applyDeltas never aborts on a hallucinated id.
author: alessandro@pungitore.ch

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if(!process.env.CI)throw new Error('publish via release.yml CI: push a v* tag. Manual npm publish is blocked to guarantee provenance + version sync.')"
